topic: Side Position Light Control Interface Specifications
row_semantics: Each row represents a distinct control interface for a specific side position light (left front, right front, left rear) with its associated parameters and usage instructions.

column_semantics.1: Function Name: Identifies the specific side position light control function.
column_semantics.2: Consumption: Indicates the system or module that consumes this service interface.
column_semantics.4: Controller/Module: Specific controller or module name (e.g., LHZCU, RHZCU, RZCU).
column_semantics.5: ICB: Interface Control Block component involved.

core_entities.name: SidePositionLight.ControlSidePositionLight
core_entities.description: The generic service interface for controlling side position lights.

core_entities.name: ControlSidePositionLightReq
core_entities.description: The request parameter structure for the control interface.

core_entities.name: InstanceID
core_entities.description: An identifier to specify which side position light is being controlled (e.g., 1 for left front, 2 for right front, etc.).

core_entities.name: 0x0=OFF
core_entities.description: Command to turn off the specified side position light.

core_entities.name: 0x1=ON
core_entities.description: Command to turn on the specified side position light.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for controlling the left front, right front, and left rear side position lights, specifying the required parameters and command values (ON/OFF) for each. It is used to verify that the correct service interface is called with the appropriate parameters to achieve the desired lighting state.
